conditions.notes: Back-EMF fundamental at W_REF (10000 rpm), from the 3-channel 20-120 rps speed sweep: psi_f_measured 0.268 mWb x n_p 6 x 1047.2 rad/s. Linear fit of V_peak vs omega forced through origin, R^2 = 0.99997; W_REF sits above the swept range, extrapolated via the fit.

provenance_note: Import-format distillation of the raw sweep (backemf_speed_sweep.json + captures/). Deliberately NOT tagged derived_params: the motor TOML omits psi_f (derived from B_rem) and carries nominal N52 B_rem = 1.45 T, so fitting B_rem against this dataset is the flagship calibration case (manual inversion -> effective B_rem 1.139 T; since automated, REQ-0819). Uncertainty ~1% from the per-channel Ke spread (1.599-1.612 mV/(rad/s)).
